items.label: Verify evaporator fan operation, coil cleanliness/ice, air path and product obstruction
Verify condenser fan operation, coil cleanliness, airflow, ambient and hot-air recirculation
Measure evaporator superheat using the applicable refrigerant and target/reference
items.why: Do not repeat this check when superheat is already measured, even if no classification target is available.

items.label: Measure subcooling using the applicable refrigerant and target/reference
items.why: Measures liquid-side condition. Low/high/retained classification still requires an applicable reference.

items.label: Measure inlet and outlet temperature across the liquid-line filter drier under stable flow; pressure drop is optional corroboration when service access exists
Inspect suspected leak locations and confirm with an appropriate leak-detection method
Verify TXV bulb contact/location, equalizer, sizing, refrigerant compatibility and inlet conditions
Observe a complete defrost and verify schedule, duration, termination, heaters/fan delay and coil clearing
Check doors/gaskets, traffic, warm product load and airflow obstruction
Verify liquid-line solenoid command, coil, opening/closing and pressure/flow condition
Verify LP/HP control state and settings against application requirements
Verify setpoint, differential, sensor placement/calibration and alarm history
Check suction/discharge pressures, current, discharge temperature and model operating envelope
Verify solid liquid / no flash gas at TXV inlet
items.why: Separates inadequate liquid supply/pressure loss from a metering-device problem.

items.label: Check TXV response to bulb/load change and inspect power element
items.why: Helps distinguish valve/power-element fault from low charge or upstream restriction.

items.label: Inspect TXV inlet screen/orifice for restriction/ice/debris
items.why: Localizes a feed restriction at the expansion-valve inlet.

items.label: Verify defrost heater voltage/current and actual heat
items.why: Separates heater/power failure from schedule/termination/infiltration causes.

items.label: Verify defrost termination sensor/control against actual coil temperature
Verify head-pressure control/fan cycling for current ambient
items.why: Separates control-related high-side behavior from airflow/ambient/charge causes.

items.label: Verify compressor runs and compare suction/discharge pressure separation
items.why: Separates compressor/power/pumping problems from load/feed problems.

items.label: Confirm operating state
Inspect drain, pan and drain heat for blockage/refreeze
Measure compressor terminal voltage during a cooling/start call
Check contactor coil command and line/load voltage
Compare controller sensor to an independent temperature measurement and verify location
Inspect door/gasket/infiltration and characterize product load
Verify liquid-solenoid command and actual refrigerant flow during pump-down
Compare verified equipment capacity with actual/design room load
Obtain the actual wiring diagram and confirm the controller/safety state
After finding an open fuse, inspect downstream wiring/load and determine the overcurrent cause before replacement/restart
Identify head-pressure-control type, setting and required flood-charge configuration
Verify compressor suction/discharge pressures and pumping differential under a valid operating state
Verify solenoid coil voltage, pressure differential and actual opening/flow
Verify evaporator outlet pressure measurement, connection and stability before using calculated superheat
Measure suction/discharge pressures and electrical values, then compare with model-specific operating data
Determine whether high head, low suction/high superheat, load or electrical conditions caused compressor overheating before replacing protection/compressor
